notes.title: v1.0.20
notes.notes:
[p]Hi, everyone and happy friday![/p]
The latest 1.0.20 update brings few more improvements:
[list]
[*] Smarter and more challenging AI
[*] New feature: Last Attack! — the match continues until your attack is over
[*] Extra Time added for Knockout games — if it’s a draw, play on up to 120 minutes!
[*] Fixed issues with navigation in the menu via gamepad
[/list]

[p]Hi, everyone!
The new 1.0.19 update is here!
[p]
[olist]
[*] New "Adaptive" complexity level
[*] The AI of teammates has been improved
[*] Corner kicks have been improved
[*] The time of the match has been slightly increased
[*] Minor bugfixes
[/olist]

Let me know if you will encounter any issues!
